title: Home life in Late Autumn - A Cozy Cottage
en: good afternoon everyone and welcome back to my home today i'm in a creative mood while my craft of choice is usually painting i always like to challenge myself to learn new things today i'm working with natural fibers since i love the smell and texture of wool i'm always attracted to projects that are slow and methodical they make me feel connected to my past hmm this project was inspired by a book written nearly a hundred years ago that delighted many children and adults alike it is about a toy rabbit that desperately wants to be real the rabbit belongs to a little boy and spends much of his time in the nursery where he befriends a rocking horse that is very old and very wise he explains to the rabbit that with enough love he will become real and when he becomes real he won't be afraid of pain anymore instead he will feel honored by those feelings
that while painful remind him of the blessing of his life children's books are full of surprisingly simple wisdom do do

so to quote the wise old rocking horse from the velveteen rabbit you become it takes a long time that's why it doesn't happen often to people who break easily or have sharp edges or have to be carefully kept generally by the time you are real most of your hair has been loved off and your eyes drop out and you get loose in the joints and very shabby but these things don't matter at all because once you are real you can't be ugly except to people who don't understand oh so

so children's stories fables and folklore often feature anthropomorphized animals these stories hold much value to me because my love for animals has been an innate part of my person since i was born in times of great sadness in my life i found that having to care for an animal much like caring for a child would force me to step outside of myself and focus on another living being to serve instead of dwell on my melancholy so wild animals impact me in a different way if you've ever had the honor of looking straight into the eyes of a creature of the wilderness be it the perfectly round oculus of an owl or the soft brown oval of a deer

moose or bear it is an experience that stays ingrained in your memory it is both magical and humbling once i found myself returning the gaze of a great horned owl while carrying firewood back to my mother's home we regarded each other for a long while its dark eyes shocked me with a reminder that this elegant creature knew so many things that i could never even begin to understand it was a complex biology built from countless ancestors that had come before it had so many skills that i would never be able to attain a formidable challenge to our human perception of what it is to have higher intelligence i encourage you to seek out a natural area near your home and see what animals you encounter no matter how commonplace or small each one has a fascinating story to tell
zh: 大家下午好，欢迎今天回到我的家，我处于一种创造性的心情，而我选择的手艺通常是绘画，我总是喜欢挑战自己学习新事物，今天我正在使用天然纤维，因为我喜欢羊毛的气味和质地，我总是被缓慢而有条理的项目所吸引，它们让我感觉与我的过去有联系，嗯，这个项目的灵感来自一本近一百年前写的书，这本书让许多孩子和成人都感到高兴，它是关于一只玩具兔子，它拼命想要成为真实的兔子，它属于一个小兔子。男孩大部分时间都在托儿所里，在那里他与一匹非常古老且非常聪明的摇马成为了朋友，他向兔子解释说，只要有足够的爱，他就会变得真实，当他变得真实时，他将不再害怕痛苦，相反，他会为这些感觉感到荣幸
痛苦的同时提醒他生命中的祝福 儿童读物充满了令人惊讶的简单智慧
所以引用天鹅绒兔子里那句聪明的老摇马的话，你要花很长时间才能变成这样，这就是为什么这种情况不会经常发生在那些容易折断或有锋利边缘的人身上，或者在你真正的时候必须小心翼翼地保存的时候，你的大部分头发都被爱掉了，你的眼睛掉下来了，你的关节松了，非常破旧，但这些事情根本不重要，因为一旦你是真实的，你就不会丑陋，除非对那些不理解的人哦所以
所以儿童故事、寓言和民间传说经常以拟人化的动物为主角，这些故事对我来说很有价值，因为自从我出生在我生命中最悲伤的时期以来，我对动物的热爱一直是我与生俱来的一部分，我发现必须像照顾孩子一样照顾动物会迫使我走出自我，专注于另一个生物来服务，而不是沉浸在我的忧郁中，所以如果你有幸直视野生动物，野生动物会以不同的方式影响我。荒野生物的眼睛，无论是猫头鹰的完美圆形眼珠还是鹿的柔和棕色椭圆形

驼鹿或熊，这是一种在你的记忆中根深蒂固的经历，它既神奇又令人谦卑，当我在搬木柴回母亲家时，我发现自己回望了一只大角鸮的目光，我们互相对视了很长一段时间，它的黑眼睛让我震惊，提醒我，这种优雅的生物知道很多我永远无法开始理解的事情，它是一种复杂的生物，由无数的祖先构建而成，在它拥有如此多的技能之前，我永远无法对我们的人类构成巨大的挑战。人类对高智力的看法 我鼓励您寻找您家附近的自然区域，看看您遇到了哪些动物，无论多么平凡或多小，每只动物都有一个引人入胜的故事可讲
